name: 无线便携冷热风快干吹风机款
description: 无线便携随手吹、冷热风多档调节、低噪快干、简约白机身的口袋吹风机

styleLock.backgroundSystem: soft off-white #F2F1EF and light neutral grey #E3E4E6 studio panels for product shots; deep charcoal #1C1C1C rounded banner or tiles for performance and closing screens
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft diffused studio lighting, gentle soft-box key from the front-left, soft contact shadows, controlled low-contrast highlights on the white shell
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper and matte light-grey board, no texture clutter
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif type, charcoal #1C1C1C on light panels and #FFFFFF on charcoal panels
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line icons and thin leader-line callouts, single accent color
styleLock.presentationRules: product always crisp clean white shell with brushed-silver trim, stable scale, cleanly cropped with soft contact shadow grounding; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent minimal modern appliance ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of soft off-white #F2F1EF, light neutral grey #E3E4E6, deep charcoal #1C1C1C and one brushed-silver accent #C8CDD2; bright soft diffused studio lighting with a gentle front-left soft-box key and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif type; consistent rounded rectangular info cards and thin leader-line callouts; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic panels; stable product scale with the white shell cleanly rendered against calm neutral panels; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的合规主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level view at a slight 3/4 front angle, handle down, full product visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill, soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view at a slight 3/4 front angle, handle down, full product visible and not clipped by the frame, the product filling 60-70% of the frame so the composition reads complete. Bright even high-key studio lighting, soft front-left key with fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the product. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. 8K, commercial appliance e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no colored background, no floating product, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒传达快干便携的核心卖点，主视觉冲击
shots.camera: dynamic diagonal composition, photographed from a low angle looking slightly upward, product sweeping across the upper right of frame
shots.lighting: soft diffused studio light from the upper left, gentle gradient falloff, soft drop shadow under the product
shots.background: split light-grey studio backdrop, upper panel #E8E8E8 and lower panel #F0F0F0
shots.textZone: top-left one short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #1C1C1C with one sub-line 「{selling_point_1}」
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Dynamic diagonal composition photographed from a low angle looking slightly upward, the product sweeping across the upper right and filling 60-70% of the frame, tilted 30 degrees for energy. Soft diffused studio light from the upper left, soft drop shadow beneath. Split light-grey backdrop, upper panel #E8E8E8 and lower panel #F0F0F0, with subtle dot-pattern accents in #D5D5D5. The top-left area carries one short headline 「{callout_1}」 in #1C1C1C and one sub-line 「{selling_point_1}」, balancing the diagonal product against the type and completing the composition. Negative: no brand badge, no watermark on the product body, no fake logo, no dense body text, no more than one claim, no invented performance numbers, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 并列放大旧吹风机的三大困扰，为卖点让路
shots.camera: flat top-down 90-degree infographic layout, no product camera angle needed
shots.lighting: even flat high-key lighting, no dramatic shadow
shots.background: soft off-white #F2F1EF with three light-grey rounded cards #DBDBDB in a row
shots.productOccupancy: 25-35% (small clean product inset at the bottom)
shots.textZone: one bold headline 「{selling_point_1}」 in #1C1C1C at the top, three pain labels 「{callout_1}」 「{callout_2}」 「{callout_3}」 centered one per card, one short reassurance line below the cards
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point infographic for {product}, flat top-down 90-degree layout. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Three light-grey rounded cards #DBDBDB in a row on soft off-white #F2F1EF, each card carrying one short pain label 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」 in #1C1C1C. One bold headline 「{selling_point_1}」 at the top and one short reassurance line below the cards, the cards filling the body of the screen with even margins. Even flat high-key lighting. A small clean product inset sits at the bottom occupying 25-35%. Negative: no fabricated statistics, no scary medical claims, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no brand badge.

shots.intent: 微距呈现机身做工与进风格栅细节
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile, tight zoom on the rear air-inlet grille
shots.lighting: raking side light from the right revealing the grille texture and shell finish, shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp
shots.whitespace: minimal, detail is the whole point
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, tight zoom on the rear air-inlet grille and smooth shell seam. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a clean 90-degree side profile, shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Negative: no blurry subject, no duplicated grille pattern, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no props.

provenance.notes: 从 6 张便携吹风机爆款详情切片提炼。已剥离：源品牌徽章与机身水印、型号、红色促销贴纸与二维码、原文案（含不可验证的转速/速干数值，改为 {selling_point} 或 {callout} 文案槽位由使用方填写）、灰色占位图块。产品一律以 {product} 占位，不发明任何认证与数据。
